marketplace.note: Existing fa uses بازار for lowercase marketplace; the proper name Marketplace is sometimes left in English in admin strings.

post.note: Existing fa mixes پست (majority) and نوشته; prefer پست. In most UI strings 'post' and 'message' are interchangeable — پیام is fine where it reads more naturally.

thread.note: Existing fa is very inconsistent (موضوع، گفت‌وگو، رشته، نخ، تاپیک). The Threads view is موضوعات in both webapp and mobile, so standardize on موضوع. Plural: موضوعات.

direct message.note: Majority rendering in webapp/server. Mobile sometimes uses گفت‌وگوی شخصی — standardize on پیام مستقیم.

mention.note: Verb: اشاره کردن. Established across webapp and mobile; do not use the transliteration منشن.

notification.note: Plural: اعلان‌ها. Majority rendering; some older webapp strings use اطلاعیه — prefer اعلان.

pin.note: Majority rendering (پین شده، پین کردن به کانال). سنجاق کردن (Telegram convention) also appears; standardize on پین.

bookmark.note: Verb: نشانک‌گذاری کردن. Matches the one existing server string and standard Persian (Firefox) usage.

saved messages.note: save (verb) = ذخیره کردن، unsave = حذف از ذخیره‌شده‌ها. Avoid the mistranslation صرفه جویی seen in some webapp strings.

scheduled post.note: No existing fa signal; follows standard Persian UI convention (زمان‌بندی for scheduling).

emoji.note: Webapp (user-facing) uses ایموجی; server strings use شکلک. Standardize on ایموجی.

away.note: Majority rendering; mobile once uses غایب — prefer دور.

online.note: Majority rendering; mobile sometimes uses برخط — prefer آنلاین.

offline.note: Majority rendering; mobile sometimes uses برون‌خط — prefer آفلاین.

guest.note: Plural: مهمانان. Spelling مهمان (not میهمان) is the strong majority.

system admin.note: مدیر is the strong majority for admin (مدیران سیستم); some webapp role labels use ادمین سیستم — prefer مدیر سیستم.

session.note: Existing fa consistently uses جلسه/جلسات for login sessions; نشست would be more precise Persian but keep جلسه for consistency.

sign in.note: Full verb: وارد شدن. Translate 'log in' identically.

sign out.note: Full verb: خارج شدن. خروج از حساب also used for Log out — plain خروج is fine as a button label.

join.note: e.g. پیوستن به کانال. Avoid the misspelling محلق شوید present in some existing strings (should be ملحق).

archive.note: Adjective: بایگانی‌شده. Majority rendering; آرشیو also appears — prefer بایگانی.

unarchive.note: Existing fa mixes لغو بایگانی and از بایگانی خارج کردن; the latter is clearer Persian.

mute.note: For channels this silences notifications; existing webapp uses نادیده گرفتن کانال but بی‌صدا کردن is the majority and matches Calls usage. Unmute: باصدا کردن.

favorite.note: Verb: برگزیده کردن; Favorites category: برگزیده‌ها.

search.note: Verb: جستجو کردن. Use the closed spelling جستجو (majority), not جست‌وجو.

integration.note: Plural: ادغام‌ها. Existing majority; یکپارچه‌سازی is arguably a better Persian rendering of 'integration' but keep ادغام for consistency.

webhook.note: Established transliteration; existing files write it with a space (وب هوک) — prefer ZWNJ (وب‌هوک). Plural: وب‌هوک‌ها.

plugin.note: Majority rendering; پلاگین also appears — prefer افزونه.

bot.note: ربات and بات both appear in roughly equal numbers; standardize on ربات (Telegram convention). Bot account: حساب ربات.

permission.note: Plural: مجوزها. Note: existing fa also uses مجوز for 'license'; where both occur together, use اجازه/دسترسی for permission to disambiguate.

license.note: Existing fa consistently uses مجوز for license, colliding with permission = مجوز. Use لایسنس only if a string needs both concepts distinguished.

seat.note: No existing fa usage. صندلی = licensed user slot; in running text «به ازای هر کاربر» may read more naturally.

workspace.note: Majority rendering; محیط‌کار also appears — prefer فضای کاری.

invitation.note: Write with ZWNJ; existing files often use دعوت نامه with a space.

attachment.note: Strong majority; ضمیمه also appears rarely.

channel header.note: Majority uses the transliteration هدر; mobile uses سربرگ and some webapp strings use سرصفحه — standardize on هدر.

persistent notification.note: No existing fa; coined consistently with اعلان for notification.

urgent.note: Webapp uses فوری, mobile uses ضروری — standardize on فوری.

recap.note: No existing fa; جمع‌بندی conveys an activity summary better than plain خلاصه (used for 'summary').

agent.note: No existing fa. عامل is the standard Persian AI term; in marketing contexts the English 'Agent' may also be left as-is.

burn-on-read.note: No existing fa. As an adjective/label: پیام حذف‌شونده پس از خواندن; all-caps label BURN ON READ → حذف پس از خواندن.

magic link.note: پیوند is the majority rendering for 'link'; لینک جادویی is a common colloquial alternative.

personal access token.note: توکن is the majority rendering; نشانه and رمز also appear — prefer توکن.

announcement banner.note: Existing fa mixes بنر اعلامیه and بنر اطلاعیه; prefer اعلامیه for announcement (اعلان is reserved for notification).

keyword.note: Plural: کلیدواژه‌ها. Write closed with ZWNJ, not کلید واژه.

profile.note: Majority rendering; مشخصات and پروفایل also appear — prefer نمایه.

nickname.note: Existing fa is inconsistent (کنیه، لقب); کنیه is archaic — نام مستعار is the standard Persian UI term.

collapsed reply threads.note: Mobile's existing rendering (پاسخ گفت‌وگوهای جمع‌شده) is garbled; this follows thread = موضوع.

data retention.note: Existing fa mixes حفظ داده‌ها and نگهداری داده‌ها; حفظ has a slight majority. Policy: سیاست حفظ داده‌ها.

compliance export.note: Existing fa uses صادرات انطباق, but صادرات implies trade exports; خروجی is the standard Persian for file/data export.

access control.note: One existing webapp string mistranslates this as مدیریت کانال — do not follow it.

attribute.note: Custom profile attribute: ویژگی سفارشی نمایه.

onboarding.note: Existing fa leaves Onboarding in English; آشناسازی اولیه is a natural Persian rendering for the guided first-run experience.

Town Square.note: The existing server rendering دانشگاه (university) is a mistranslation; use میدان شهر consistently as the default channel name.
